description_en: Creates an internal endpoint for a private gateway
description_zh: 创建私有网关内网访问端点
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-gateway-intranet-linked-vpc --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGatewayIntranetLinkedVpc

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. For more information, see the private_gateway_id field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html接口返回结果中的private_gateway_id字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448581.html
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448581.html
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual switch. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448581.html
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID。如何获取虚拟交换机ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448581.html
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authoritative DNS parsing. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启权威DNS解析（默认值为false）
parameters.name: enable_authoritative_dns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC belongs
parameters.name: account_id

GatewayId.description_en: The ID of the private gateway

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request
Message.example: Successfully add intranet linked vpc for gateway
